dedupe_keys.name: zip code level data on rooftop solar battery storage and ev charging in california 2023

description: A Massachusetts Institute of Technology team assembles a 2023 California panel of rooftop PV, battery storage and electric-vehicle charging by ZIP Code Tabulation Area. Zenodo supplies a public bundle under CC BY 4.0 and links a versioned processing repository. The provider reports 2,549 ZCTAs and 50 columns spanning solar and storage capacity, charger levels, EV registrations, wind, power plants, demographics, climate, utility areas, demand and energy burden. This panel can inform spatial adoption, electricity-demand or equity scenarios for distributed infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this integrated 2023 panel. A limitation is that housing fields cover 1,717 ZCTAs and burden fields 1,669, so analyses must handle missingness. ZIP identifiers must remain text; treating them as numbers loses leading zeroes. Upstream data carry their own citation and possible rights terms despite the bundle licence. The archive and code were not downloaded or run, and no county or ZCTA statistic was independently checked.
